checkedAlternates.risk: Lampante has "Virgin Olive Oil" in its technical name.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Lampante has >2% free acidity and sensory defects, making it unfit for direct consumption without refining (group-1), unlike edible virgin grades (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Pure Olive Oil is marketed as 100% olive oil.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Classic/Pure Olive Oil is a blend of chemically/thermally refined olive oil and virgin oil (group-3), not unrefined mechanical virgin oil (group-4).

authorReview.notes: Author factual, ambiguity, and three-locale review complete.
